data.description: Elegant 2BR | Prime Downtown Location | City Views
data.long_description:
Discover elevated city living in the heart of Downtown Dubai, within the vibrant Opera District. Located in Act One | Act Two Towers (Act One), this stylish 2-bedroom apartment offers a perfect balance of comfort, modern design, and prime connectivity. Ideal for both end-users and investors, the property places you at the center of Dubai’s most iconic lifestyle destination.

Property Details:

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Built-up Area: 1,001 sq ft
Open-plan living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
Contemporary fitted kitchen
Built-in wardrobes

Property Amenities:

Swimming pool
Fully equipped fitness center
24-hour security and concierge
Covered parking
High-speed elevators
Residents’ lounge and communal spaces

Location Highlights:

Walking distance to Dubai Opera
Minutes from Burj Khalifa
Close to The Dubai Mall
Easy access to Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard
Surrounded by fine dining, cafes, and entertainment venues
